captions.detailed: An industrial cantilevered articulated robotic arm extending horizontally from a dark grey rectangular wall-mounting plate. The arm consists of two thick, orange structural links connected by serial revolute joints, and terminates in a dark grey end-effector. It features a swivel joint at the base plate, a middle elbow joint, and a wrist joint, allowing multi-axis horizontal and vertical rotation.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a wall-mounted articulated robotic arm. The design should include a dark grey rectangular base plate with four mounting holes, connected via a vertical hinge to a series of two orange structural links with hollowed rectangular sections and cylindrical joint heads, ending in a dark grey block-shaped end-effector.
captions.factory: Construct the base plate as a rectangular box with four through-holes subtracted near the corners. Build the articulated arm by defining three distinct links: a base link with a hinge bracket, two orange intermediate links featuring central cutouts and cylindrical pivots, and a final end-effector block. Use CadQuery workplane operations including extrusions, sweeps, and boolean cuts to shape the joints, then assemble them in an articulated structure with defined rotational joint limits.
